adjudication.rationale: In handleCancelBooking.ts the code was changed from a single `_calendar` reference (`find`) to multiple (`filter`) and then loops `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)`. Inside the recurring-cancel branch it still builds `promises` from `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(..._calendar)` (organizer/user credentials), not from the credentials implied by each `reference` or other hosts. It also deletes events for `updatedBookings` using only the first calendar reference per booking (`updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes("_calendar"))`), so if a booking has multiple calendar references (now supported elsewhere in the diff via destinationCalendar arrays), only one is deleted. Because this recurring branch sits inside the outer loop, the same Promise.all work can run once per reference, causing redundant calls while still missing other references’ deletions.
